formulas.formula_summary: Positional strength: combines dignity/exaltation, divisional dignity, odd/even sign rules, kendra/drekkana and related school-specific subcomponents.
formulas.unit_contract: Virupa component; conversion to Rupa must be explicit, usually 60 Virupa = 1 Rupa.
formulas.license_boundary: PyJHora/JHora AGPL evidence is oracle-only; do not copy implementation. VedAstro hosted identity blocked.
formulas.claim_boundary: component method variant allowed; absolute Virupa truth blocked until worked example/unit source closes.

formulas.formula_summary: Directional strength by angular distance from planet-specific strongest direction/house.
formulas.unit_contract: Virupa component; cap/floor and interpolation must be explicit.
formulas.license_boundary: AGPL sources oracle-only; local implementation must remain independently written.
formulas.claim_boundary: directional component can be compared only after house/cusp semantics are declared.

formulas.formula_summary: Temporal strength aggregation: day/night, paksha, tribhaga, year/month/day/hora lord and ayana-related subcomponents depending on lineage.
formulas.unit_contract: Virupa component; each subcomponent must name local time, sunrise/sunset, ayana and cap rules.
formulas.license_boundary: Use local astronomy implementation; external packages oracle-only unless permissive and audited.
formulas.claim_boundary: blocked for absolute parity until each Kala subcomponent has source and worked example.

formulas.formula_summary: Motional strength from apparent speed/retrogression state; luminary and inner/outer planet policies vary by lineage.
formulas.unit_contract: Virupa component; speed basis and retrograde/mean-motion normalization must be explicit.
formulas.license_boundary: Cannot copy AGPL PyJHora Chesta implementation; independent local formula required.
formulas.claim_boundary: absolute Chesta parity blocked until mean-motion/Seeghrochcha source closes.

formulas.formula_summary: Natural strength assigned by fixed planetary order/brightness tradition.
formulas.unit_contract: Fixed Virupa table for seven visible planets; table source must be named.
formulas.license_boundary: Formula table can be independently sourced; AGPL oracle output not copied as implementation.
formulas.claim_boundary: lowest risk component, still requires explicit table source for absolute claim.

formulas.formula_summary: Aspectual strength from benefic/malefic aspects on planet; depends on aspect model, orb/interpolation and natural/functional treatment policy.
formulas.unit_contract: Virupa component; positive/negative sign and aspect-strength scale must be explicit.
formulas.license_boundary: Use source-cited formula; AGPL and hosted outputs remain oracle/reference only.
formulas.claim_boundary: blocked for absolute parity until aspect strength table/model is pinned.

formulas.formula_summary: Total strength derived from six component sums; may expose Virupa and/or Rupa.
formulas.unit_contract: Must state whether values are raw Virupa, Rupa, normalized ratio, or required-strength ratio.
formulas.license_boundary: Do not normalize to a single truth by majority vote.
formulas.claim_boundary: total is blocked until six components close.

formulas.formula_summary: Bhinna Ashtakavarga: per-planet 12-sign bindu table from contributor rules.
formulas.unit_contract: Integer bindu counts by sign; contributor set, Lagna inclusion, and row/column order required.
formulas.license_boundary: Permissive references may be adapted only after formula audit; AGPL oracle-only.
formulas.claim_boundary: table variant allowed; exact truth blocked until worked BAV table source matches.

formulas.formula_summary: Sarvashtakavarga: summed bindu table across BAV contributors.
formulas.unit_contract: 12 integer sign scores; whether reduced/shodhita or raw SAV must be explicit.
known_variants: rounding not applicable but indexing critical
formulas.license_boundary: Do not treat web calculator output as formula source.
formulas.claim_boundary: SAV mismatch cannot close until BAV contributor and shodhana state close.

source_evidence: external articles mention reductions and Shodhya Pinda
formulas.formula_summary: Optional reductions and Pinda weighting after raw BAV/SAV depending on school.
formulas.unit_contract: Must label raw, reduced, trikona/ekadhipatya shodhana, and shodhya pinda separately.
formulas.license_boundary: Needs formula source and worked example before implementation.
